_comment: VERIFIED eRaksha facts only. Fill from eRaksha's own documentation; every entry needs evidence (document name/URL and date). Leave arrays empty if unknown. The app shows nothing that is not in this file, except visitor-entered scenarios which are always labelled as scenarios. See docs/ERAKSHA_INPUT.md.

_coverage_example_do_not_use.scope: e.g. 'Pilot in 12 schools, Pune' — describe exactly what is covered; a country is shaded if ANY verified service exists there
_coverage_example_do_not_use.users_reached_definition: e.g. 'registered child accounts' — required if users_reached is given

_outcome_evidence_note: Leave empty unless a study with a defined outcome, population, comparison and effect size exists. Without it the app shows coverage only and health-benefit calculations stay unavailable.
